extension.summary: Live TV, TV guide, catch-up, movies and series from your Xtream Codes provider
extension.description: Watch your Xtream Codes IPTV subscription in Kodi, without the PVR IPTV Simple client.[CR][CR][B]Live TV[/B]: TV mode with channel list, mini player and programme schedule; fast Up/Down and CH+/CH- zapping with a channel banner; number entry and channel recall (0); favourites; a full grid TV guide; offline channels detected and skipped.[CR][B]Catch-up[/B]: watch earlier programmes, or restart the current one from its beginning with the Rewind key.[CR][B]Movies and series[/B]: browse by category, recently added, resume and Continue watching, optional export to the Kodi library.[CR][B]Discover[/B]: trending, popular and top-rated titles with TMDb ratings, showing only what your provider has.[CR][B]Also[/B]: search (including the TV guide), reminders, sleep timer, Trakt scrobbling, hide or rename groups, adult filter with PIN, backup and restore, configurable User-Agent, background channel and EPG updates, and an option to start straight into TV mode.[CR][CR]You need a subscription from an Xtream Codes provider. This add-on does not provide any content.
extension.news: 1.13.0: faster remote keys in fullscreen live TV - the channel banner appears at once (keys are handled by the background service; setting "Fast remote keys"). The banner now shows before the channel starts opening. 1.12.4: Up/Down right as a channel starts is no longer ignored.
